_readme: Curated, verified notices only. Every fact below was checked against the official source in source_url on the last_verified date. Any detail the official source does not state is "not_confirmed" — never fill it in from news reports or guesswork. The special county key "national" holds notices that apply everywhere; they are shown for every county. Re-verify before any demo, and remove notices once their deadline has passed. Notices marked with an unconfirmed deadline stay listed until removed by hand — check them periodically. Run `pnpm test` after every edit.

notices.title: The Public Participation Bill, 2025 — Senate is taking public comments
notices.summary: A national Bill (National Assembly Bills No. 44 of 2025) that creates a legal framework for how public participation is carried out, including how the public must be notified and given reasonable time to make submissions. It has been approved by the National Assembly and is now before the Senate, which accepts comments on it online.
notices.submission_instructions: Open the Senate bills page, find "The Public Participation Bill, 2025 (National Assembly Bills No. 44 of 2025) - as approved by NA" and use its "Submit Comments" form.
notices.source_name: Senate of Kenya — Bills page (Parliament of Kenya website)

notices.title: Tobacco Control (Amendment) Bill — Parliament public hearing in Nairobi
notices.summary: The National Assembly's Departmental Committee on Health is collecting public views on a Bill (Senate Bill No. 35 of 2024) that would regulate electronic nicotine delivery systems, including e-cigarettes. You can attend the Nairobi hearing to give your views in person or hand in a written memorandum.
notices.venue: Mini Chamber, County Hall, Parliament Buildings, Nairobi — Thursday 24 September 2026, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM
notices.submission_instructions: Appear at the public hearing to give oral views and submit written memoranda on the Bill. Copies of the Bill are on the Parliament website: https://www.parliament.go.ke/the-national-assembly/house-business/bills
notices.source_name: National Assembly of Kenya — Notification of Public Hearings and Invitation to Submit Views (Clerk of the National Assembly)
